reportTemplate.summary: Completed on the Grafana dashboard "{{v1}}" (uid {{v4}}). I entered edit mode, confirmed the top bar read "Time range selected: {{v3}}" and auto-refresh "1m", then opened Save dashboard. Finding: this build's save drawer renders the two "Update default ..." checkboxes only when the current pickers differ from the dashboard's stored defaults — with everything already matching it presented just "No changes to save" and a disabled Save with no checkbox elements in the DOM (live-DOM verified). So that the tick could be performed on a real save, I first set the pickers apart (12h/5m), which surfaced both checkboxes; I ticked BOTH, saw the "Changes (2)" tab and an enabled Save, and saved (page status "Dashboard saved"). I then restored the pickers to {{v3}} + 1m, reopened Save dashboard, ticked BOTH checkboxes again ("Changes2" tab), and clicked Save — page status/alert "Dashboard saved". I exited edit mode (toolbar now Mark as favorite / Share / Edit, no unsaved-changes marker). Verified afterwards: top bar "{{v3}}" and "1m", URL .../{{v5}}?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m, tag 'bench' present as a removable chip in Dashboard settings → General, and both panels rendered ({{v2}} Notes → "Notes for run {{v2}}"; {{v2}} Availability → 16.5).
